texts.zh: 宇宙风暴过境[from.solar_system.GetName]星系时改变了该恒星的外观。在风暴的余波过后，这颗恒星的日冕层呈现出异彩纷呈的漩涡，向四面八方喷射出五光十色的耀斑。这一现象值得进一步分析。
texts.en: The passing of a cosmic storm through the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has transformed the visual appearance of the system's star. In the aftermath of the storm, the star's coronal layer presents as a swirl of ever-changing colors, ejecting polychromatic flares in all directions. The phenomenon warrants further analysis.

sections.en: The passing of a cosmic storm through the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has transformed the visual appearance of the system's star. In the aftermath of the storm, the star's coronal layer presents as a swirl of ever-changing colors, ejecting polychromatic flares in all directions. The phenomenon warrants further analysis.

texts.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]汇报了自[from.GetAffectedStormType]过境以来，[From.GetStarName]的聚变反应所发生的奇妙变化。

显然，这个风暴引发了恒星内核某种意想不到的核反应，导致其对流区稳定地释放出[from.GetEarnedResources]。

这些复杂而特殊的反应产生了我们所观察到的这些不寻常的多色闪光。无论如何，在一段时间内这的都会一直是一个值得仔细研究的来源。
texts.en:
[root.leader.GetName] reports fascinating changes in [From.GetStarName]'s fusion reactions since the passage of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

It appears that the storm induced unexpected nuclear reactions within the star's core, resulting in a steady release of [from.GetEarnedResources] from its convective zones.

These complex and idiosyncratic reactions are producing the unusual polychromatic flaring we have observed. In any case, it will continue to be a source worthy of close study for some time.
